theorems.name: Submission.dohr_eb_sch_weak_eq_affine_rescale
theorems.statement: ∀ (n ℓ : ℕ) (a : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (Φ : Rn n → (Rn n →L[ℝ] Rn ℓ) →L[ℝ] ℝ) (w : Rn n → Rn ℓ) (U : Set (Rn n)) (y z₀ : Rn n) (ρ r : ℝ), 0 < ρ → IsOpen U → ball (y + ρ • z₀) (ρ * r) ⊆ U → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 w U → (∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ U → ∫ x in U, a x (fderiv ℝ w x) (fderiv ℝ ζ x) = ∫ x in U, Φ x (fderiv ℝ ζ x)) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 (fun z => w (y + ρ • z)) (ball z₀ r) ∧ (∀ z ∈ ball z₀ r, fderiv ℝ (fun z => w (y + ρ • z)) z = ρ • fderiv ℝ w (y + ρ • z)) ∧ ∀ ζ : Rn n → Rn ℓ, ContDiff ℝ 1 ζ → HasCompactSupport ζ → tsupport ζ ⊆ ball z₀ r → ∫ z in ball z₀ r, a (y + ρ • z) (fderiv ℝ (fun z => w (y + ρ • z)) z) (fderiv ℝ ζ z) = ∫ z in ball z₀ r, (ρ • Φ (y + ρ • z)) (fderiv ℝ ζ z)
